headline: Apple seeks settlement talks with Epic Games in new court filing
summary: Apple has filed a motion indicating its willingness to explore a settlement with Epic Games regarding their ongoing App Store lawsuit. This marks a potential shift in the long-running legal dispute.
details: Apple has officially filed a motion indicating its willingness to explore a settlement with Epic Games. This development comes in the context of their long-standing legal battle over App Store policies.
The motion suggests a potential shift in strategy for Apple, which has previously maintained a firm stance in the dispute. The specifics of the proposed settlement talks have not been disclosed.

The lawsuit, initiated by Epic Games in 2020, challenged Apple's App Store rules, particularly the 30% commission and restrictions on alternative payment systems. Courts have issued mixed rulings over the years.

A settlement could potentially avoid further lengthy appeals and establish new precedents for app distribution and monetization on iOS platforms. Both companies have invested significant resources in the legal proceedings.
